Definition: of Hebrew origin (H5146); Noë, (i.e. Noäch), a patriarch:--Noe.
BiblicalUsage: Noe is the Greek form of Noah, and Jesus Himself uses it as the measure of His coming: as the days of Noe were, so shall the coming of the Son of Man be. Luke carries him in the genealogy, and Hebrews says that by faith Noah, warned of things not seen, prepared an ark to the saving of his house.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the days of Noe are the warning Jesus chose: life went on eating and drinking until the flood came, and His coming will find the world the same way.
